svg.aria-label: Weekly contribution skyline: one 3D bar per week, taller means more contributions
svg.text: Each 3D bar is one week of GitHub work (commits, PRs, issues). The taller the bar, the more I did that week.
Last 26 weeks, oldest on the left, this week on the right.
Short blue bar = a quiet week. Tall pink bar = a busy week. Number on top = contributions that week. Gold number = my best week.
